description: Deletes one of the account's API keys, by id or by name. Anything that uses the key stops working at once, so the first call deletes nothing: it shows the key (name, scopes, last used) for the user to approve; call again with confirm:true only after their yes. Use it to clean up a key you created for a task that is finished.

confirm.description: Set true ONLY after the user has explicitly approved deleting this key (see the confirmation the first call returns). Do NOT set it yourself.

name.description: Or the key's name, when exactly one key has it.

name: delete_api_key
title: Delete an API key (needs approval)
